verdict.rationale:
Angular's component model combines an HTML template, CSs styles, and TypeScript logic within a single component definition, and both first-party docs (components, dependency injection) and community accounts confirm encapsulated, reusable components built with known web tech. However, evidence is high-level marketing copy with no explicit walkthrough of the @Component decorator syntax (template/styleUrls/class together) or single-file component structure, and some community notes flag tooling friction around the HTML-like template syntax.

missing for 10: explicit docs/examples showing @Component decorator combining templateUrl/styleUrls/class, first-party single-file component tutorial, independent hands-on praise specifically for colocated markup+style+logic.
